doc-mietvertrag.plainEnglishSummary: An open-ended rental agreement for a two-room flat in Berlin-Neukölln, starting 1 April 2024. Rent is €890 per month plus €210 in advance service charges. Either side can end it in writing; your notice period is three months.

actionItems.text: To move out you must give three months' notice.
Notice must be given in writing, on paper. Email does not count.
A deposit of €2,670 (three months' cold rent) is due. You may pay it in three instalments.
actionItems.sourceQuote: Der Mieter leistet eine Kaution in Höhe von 2.670 €, zahlbar in drei Raten.

actionItems.text: Rent is due by the third working day of each month.
actionItems.sourceQuote: Die Miete ist spätestens am dritten Werktag eines jeden Monats zu zahlen.

keyTakeaways.text: Service charges are settled once a year, so you may owe a top-up.
keyTakeaways.sourceQuote: Über die Vorauszahlungen wird jährlich abgerechnet.

keyTakeaways.text: You pay for small repairs up to €100 each, capped at €300 a year.
keyTakeaways.sourceQuote: Kleinreparaturen bis zu 100 € im Einzelfall, höchstens 300 € jährlich.

doc-versicherungsschein.plainEnglishSummary: Your health insurer confirms your membership and announces a higher additional contribution from January. Because of the increase you have a special right to switch insurer.

actionItems.text: Your contribution rises by 0.4 percentage points from 1 January. You can switch insurer until 31 January.

keyTakeaways.text: Professional teeth cleaning is reimbursed up to €80 a year.

doc-finanzamt.plainEnglishSummary: The tax office reminds you to file your 2023 income tax return. No tax is being assessed yet.

actionItems.text: File your 2023 tax return by 31 July 2024, or a late-filing fee may be charged.
